en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2045 - It is narrated from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:

"I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about fasting during the Days of Tashreeq.
Imam (as) replied: 'The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) only prohibited fasting on those days in Mina. However, outside of Mina, there is no issue with fasting them.'"
